# SequenceBinding

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("SequenceBinding")`

Tells a `SequencePlayer` which instance one of its sequence's names refers to. A sequence refers to its subjects by name, such as `Anna` or `Lamp`. A binding under the player whose `Name` is that name sets the instance, so one sequence can be played on different characters.

The tracks of a name with no binding, or with a binding whose `Target` is nil, do nothing, and the player logs a message once.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Target` | `Instance?` | `nil` | read/write | The instance the name refers to. A track targets this instance, or a descendant given by a path from it, such as `Lamp/PointLight`. |
